utility: summons all brands back to the player for re-attachment — the reposition half of the brand cycle, not a damage skill.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: TIMED-WHILE-ACTIVE-APPROX — the brand's periodic self-activation is a timed-while-active proc; no such enum member exists (R-M5), approximated to on-passive-tick as the nearest apply-event member (R-M5 accrual instance; steward counts toward the >=3 graduation bar). PoE shock -> sunder (§2 false-friend). Attached-to-enemy persistence approximated as mark + proc-loop; brand count cap (~3 active) noted as behavioral.
